verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch docs mention the CLI can 'automate monitoring' and run collection tests with JUnit reporting, implying you could wire up scheduled runs (e.g., via cron/CI) that fail a build when tests break, but there is no dedicated 'monitor' feature with built-in scheduling or alerting (email/Slack/webhook) described anywhere in the evidence. Missing for 10: a documented native monitors/scheduling UI, explicit alert-on-failure mechanism, and any independent confirmation that CLI-based monitoring actually notifies users of breakage.
